title: Google Play target API level extension deadline
summary: Developers granted an extension past Google Play's August 31, 2026 requirement that apps target Android 16 (API level 36) must bring their app into compliance by November 1, 2026 or lose the ability to publish updates to existing users.

sources.title: Target API level requirements for Google Play apps

title: Amazon OpenSearch Service extended-support surcharge increases for legacy versions
summary: Starting November 7, 2026, AWS's Extended Support surcharge for legacy Elasticsearch (1.5-7.8) and OpenSearch (1.0-1.2, 2.3-2.9) versions on Amazon OpenSearch Service increases, as AWS extends the support window a further 12 months at a higher rate rather than ending it outright.

sources.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service announces additional upgrade runway and support dates for additional versions

title: KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America 2026
summary: CNCF's cloud-native conference takes place at the Salt Palace Convention Center in Salt Lake City, with co-located events on November 9 and the main conference November 10-12.
org: Cloud Native Computing Foundation / Linux Foundation

sources.title: FAQ | LF Events - KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America

title: Azure Functions in-process .NET worker model retires
summary: Microsoft retires support for the in-process worker model for .NET apps in Azure Functions on this date, requiring migration to the isolated worker model.

sources.title: Retirement: Support for the in-process model for .NET apps in Azure Functions ends 10 November 2026

title: .NET 11 general availability
summary: .NET 11 is expected to reach general availability following monthly preview releases starting February 2026, with Preview 6 having shipped by August 2026.

title: .NET 8 and .NET 9 reach end of support
summary: Microsoft's .NET 8 (LTS) and .NET 9 (STS) both reach end of support on the same date, after which they receive no further servicing updates or security fixes.

sources.title: .NET 8 and .NET 9 will reach End of Support on November 10, 2026

title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday - November 2026
summary: Microsoft's monthly scheduled security update release, falling on the second Tuesday of the month per its published cadence.

sources.title: Next Patch Tuesday: Microsoft Update Calendar 2026

title: PowerShell 7.4 LTS and 7.5 reach end of support
summary: PowerShell 7.4 (LTS) and 7.5 reach end of support on the same date because their lifecycle is tied to the underlying .NET 8 runtime; Microsoft directs users to PowerShell 7.6 LTS.

title: Qualcomm Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings (expected)
summary: Qualcomm is expected to report fiscal Q4 2026 results on November 11, 2026 after market close, per financial-tracker estimates.

title: OpenAI's direct model access for Cursor ends
summary: The proposed transition period during which Cursor keeps direct access to the OpenAI models it uses today ends; after this date Cursor users need their own OpenAI API key or a third-party gateway.

sources.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX

title: Microsoft Ignite 2026
summary: Microsoft's annual conference for IT professionals, developers and enterprise leaders returns to Moscone Center in San Francisco, with AI and Copilot at the center of the agenda, in-person and digital attendance options.

title: NVIDIA Q3 fiscal 2027 earnings
summary: NVIDIA confirmed it will report third-quarter fiscal 2027 results and hold its conference call on November 17, 2026, firming up the previously-filed placeholder date.

sources.title: NVIDIA Sets Conference Call for Third-Quarter Financial Results

title: Claude Opus 4.5 exits minimum guaranteed support window
summary: Anthropic's model-deprecations page lists November 24, 2026 as Claude Opus 4.5's minimum guaranteed API support date, one year after its November 2025 release.

title: Amazon Bedrock retires AI21 Jamba 1.5 and TwelveLabs Marengo Embed 2.7
summary: AWS's own Jamba 1.5 Mini model-card page lists a Bedrock end-of-life date of November 26, 2026; TwelveLabs Marengo Embed 2.7's retirement is reported in the same window by third-party trackers but has not been confirmed on an AWS-authored page for that specific model.

sources.title: Amazon Bedrock Model Retirements: Claude EOL Dates, Legacy Calendar

title: Amazon EKS Kubernetes 1.31 extended support ends
summary: Amazon EKS's extended support window for Kubernetes 1.31, released to EKS in September 2024, ends November 26, 2026; clusters not upgraded by then either lose support or move to the higher extended-support hourly control-plane rate.

sources.title: Review release notes for Kubernetes versions on standard support

title: Google Cloud shuts down Vertex AI Extensions
summary: Google's Vertex AI release notes state Vertex AI Extensions is deprecated and will be shut down after November 26, 2026, with Google recommending migration to its Agent Platform to avoid disruption.

title: AWS re:Invent
summary: AWS's flagship annual conference, historically the venue for its largest infrastructure and AI service launches, runs November 30 - December 4, 2026 in Las Vegas.

sources.title: AWS re:Invent 2026 | The Premier Cloud and AI Conference | Nov 30-Dec 4, Las Vegas

title: OpenAI shuts down Evals dashboard, Agent Builder and Reusable Prompts API
summary: OpenAI's Evals dashboard/API, Agent Builder, and the reusable Prompts API (v1/prompts) close on November 30, 2026, with Evals going read-only starting October 31, 2026; OpenAI points developers to the Agents SDK or ChatGPT Workspace Agents as replacements.
